text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. Many students
seem
nervous, but as for Curren Chan...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Umastagram! It's me, Curren
Chan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I wanted to go live because I
wanted to
take some pose requests from
all of youuu!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's Day! I know I can't
give
everyone chocolates, so...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give out some cute pics
instead! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Entering for them is simple! I'll make a
post after
this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan's always dedicated to
giving her fans
what they want. Just as
I'm wondering if this is
going to go on all
day...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Bro! It's Valentine's Day! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sis! It's Valentine's Day! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I followed a recipe and made some
chocolates. ♪
Don't they just look
perfect?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? ♪ I wonder who the lucky
recipient
is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our eyes meet, and her gaze is deep
with
meaning. I'm about to ask her who
they're for,
but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I guess that's enough talk about
Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wanna get started with training? I'm
looking
forward to our session. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, during break...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, about those chocolates... I had my
roommate,
Ayabe, try them first...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But she can be so mean! She told me
they were
gross!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wanted a kind of edible flower
theme...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So I added some chrysanthemum that
came with
the sashimi.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Apparently, it wasn't very good.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then she told me not to use her as a
guinea pig
anymore. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but don't worry. I made another
batch after
that following the recipe to a
tee.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aaand that's all for our break! ♪ I'm
gonna jog
back around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She brings up Valentine's a few more
times
throughout the day, but she
doesn't say who the
chocolates are for.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whew! I worked so hard today. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Guess that's all for today. See you
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to ask who the chocolates are for,
but
considering my position, I really
can't bring it up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm gonna go then. Byeee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After training, I head off campus to take
care of
something.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe Valentine's Day is already
over. I
had a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's exchange chocolates next
year too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day's almost over. Just as I begin to
bemoan
another uneventful Valentine's
Day, I hear a
familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Bro!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I was waiting for you...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I was waiting for you...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I've still got some really important
business to
take care of, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Here! Happy Valentine's Day! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Here! Happy Valentine's Day! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You look relieved.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You look relieved.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you were worried you
weren't gonna
get any!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ha! I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... It was so adorable seeing you so

worried! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... It was so adorable seeing you so

worried! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I really poured my heart into making this

chocolate, so enjoy it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Curren Chan was playing with
me like a
puppet all day long. This has
certainly turned into
a Valentine's Day
to remember.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...So, what do you think my important
business is?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite Curren Chan's smile, I get the
impression
that she's under some kind of
pressure...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You already know, don't you? Go on.
Say it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You already know, don't you? Go on.
Say it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Valentine's what?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hrm.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You really want me to say it, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I bet you don't even want them. That's
why you're
being so quiet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I bet you don't even want them. That's
why you're
being so quiet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I put my heart into these. I never cook,
but I
picked out all the ingredients one
by one...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: All for one person and one person only...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Do you... really not want them?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! You finally said it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pressure exuding from Curren Chan

disappears. I guess she just wanted me
to beg her
for the chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then here, just for you—the chocolates I
worked
so hard on.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then here, just for you—the chocolates I
worked
so hard on.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Buuuut only if you tell me you want
them another
hundred times! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You've teased me a whole bunch, so you
can at
least do this for me, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You've teased me a whole bunch, so you
can at
least do this for me, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I end up having to tell her I want them 101 times before she finally gives them to me. They're sweet. Very sweet... Way too sweet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Did I put too much sugar in it? I
wanted
them to be just as sweet as my
feelings for you, so
please don't be
mad! ♪
